newsitem.title: USA: Bids for US vanadium pentoxide range $2.45-3.05/lb.
newsitem.headline: Bids for US vanadium pentoxide range $2.45-3.05/lb.

text.p: Five firms submitted bids for surplus U.S.-owned vanadium pentoxide ranging from $2.4500-$3.0517 per lb, the Defense National Stockpile Center said Friday.
High bidder was MRM Corp, Somerville, New Jersey, which bid $3.0517 per lb for 118,488 lbs.
Low bidder was Glencore 1, Baton Rouge, Louisiana. It offered $2.4500 per lb for 17 lots totaling about one million lbs.
The agency usually takes a day or two to review bids before making awards, if any. Bids were opened Thursday.
